ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Class sessions will be held on the following days: Jan 30; Feb. 6; Apr. 10; May 1. Wednesday sessions take place from 5:30pm to 8:30pm. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers, waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC, or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.).The waiver policy above is subject to moderate changes in accordance with the actions of the University of Illinois, Board of Trustees.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC or EDD:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $572.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
